inputs.DATA: ordered frame input bits, width 1..8; retained only until corresponding load EX finishes
inputs.FRAME_IN: bit: 0 discards uncommitted ingress, 1 accepts an immutable complete frame
inputs.RESULT_IN: control v=1 with already produced result bits, independent next-state bits and run identity; zero result data remains valid
inputs.BUSINESS_READY: bit plus externally declared frontier/state references
inputs.OUTPUT_DONE: control v=1 with trusted receipt after all actual data and marker outputs; replay marker=0 is not a missing completion

outputs.Y: actual W bit outputs from Q66..Q73
outputs.COMP_REQUEST: immutable locked input/state handoff to a separately declared finite business JKS
outputs.rejected: reason record, never a replacement business bit

scope.factory_instance: F1 bound to this R1 instance
scope.child_state: shared within this R1 instance; independent between distinct R1 instances
scope.context_forwarding: F1 always receives requester_jksid=R1 and this actual R1 instance, not the internal stage id
scope.definition_binding: freeze definitions for each admitted call; a retry cannot switch the definition
scope.clone_rule: same definition may be instantiated again, but control/state nodes are remapped to fresh model-global identities; no state sharing between R1 instances

factory_call.result: one q=0, never-publishing draft owned by R1; configure before active registration
factory_call.repeat: each actual requested data/control node uses a separate complete sequence
factory_call.domain: nested calls share the active RAM root; actual returned drafts may be used by later internal operations
factory_call.role_overrides: templates.roles may select another five-bit recipe; each invocation still begins b5=0 and ends b5=1

layout.business_attachment: when a business JKS is explicitly attached, FRAME_IN writes PRE; RESULT_IN writes POST and independent NEXT state carriers

slot.bits: only in JKI q; metadata never holds a second long-lived bit array

layout.append: use each block slot once per generation; use next safe reusable block or grow
layout.capacity: no fixed maximum blocks; resource fault retains input/task instead of silently dropping a frame

slot_value_binding.scope: per instantiated slot; $slot.load and $slot.maintain resolve to declared real control sources; state kind is preserved

emit load inputs and execute each data/flag EX from existing locked parameters
install the explicitly bound hold/read references

install.zero_data: real data, not a missing input or a completion condition

reference_closure.source: JKRD7.md section 13.8.1; concrete V7 expansion and general reference/self-reference rules remain explicitly open in section 11; validate each expanded graph before installation
reference_closure.hold: SELF is fixed q_start; required external anchor references and real readers are instantiated, not management lines
reference_closure.protected_sinks: fixed output and relay targets remain present while tasks reference them
reference_closure.gc: detach a validated complete fragment only after all readers/tasks/arrivals/output holders are released

templates.dynamic_members: actual allocated ids added by atomic registration; template placeholder ids never enter active members

data.read_by: bound B/read EX and reference-closure construction

done.ex: done_ex from the same already-existing VALUE as the associated load EX; no dependency on a future load result
done.count: one real execution per required actual width item

steps.evaluate: each load/valid EX from actual frame locks

output_protocol.prepare_order: FIFO request metadata; not a new execution FIFO
output_protocol.first_requires: POST head saved; no older head awaiting ACK1
output_protocol.qualification_requires: all actual data outputs and FRAME_OUT really completed, followed by COMPLETE transaction
output_protocol.completion_delivery: reliably enqueue completion receipt before exposing its successful FRAME_OUT receipt to subsequent ACK admission; never directly write qualification in callback
output_protocol.B_protection: first batch owns B through its qualifying completion; later first preparation cannot overwrite it
output_protocol.replay_independence: accepted H snapshot survives subsequent head consumption and reuse
output_protocol.ACK_early: DEC with valid=0 publishes no action; do not preserve it waiting for future READY
output_protocol.ACK_binding: at each DEC EX entry, then revalidate same bound frame at ACT; no retargeting
output_protocol.complete_vs_ACK: root COMPLETE never implies external business ACK received

atomicity.outer_R1: ordinary JKS; no whole-lifetime transaction and no atomic flag
atomicity.roots: stage JKS use nonempty trigger.transaction, one actual control delivery per stage call
atomicity.nested_F1: shares active root and exact parent path; no extra FIFO or separate commit
atomicity.stage_admission: all actual external bit/data parameters for that stage already available; no waiting for future independent tasks
atomicity.source_timing: PARAM latched, STATE at EX entry, SELF fixed per EX
atomicity.publications: preserve each legal publication and order; no final-value coalescing
atomicity.complete: required EX, operations and required internal deliveries settled; then commit and necessary external propagation/successor enqueue
atomicity.precommit_failure: no partial structure/q/output; retain original inputs and candidates

metadata_contract.generation: block metadata plus bound task references; not an unapproved extra JKI.pro field
metadata_contract.factory_drafts: private uninstalled records until safe configuration and commit
metadata_contract.runtime: JKS.runtime remains instance_id/pending/calls only; detailed queues, holders, metadata and recovery log are separate runtime-owned state
metadata_contract.snapshot: must include all referenced definitions, q/candidates, input presence, allocator reservations, frame/slot links, generation, batches, queues, outbox and progress; ordinary runtime view is not this checkpoint
metadata_contract.detailed_state: runtime-owned metadata is keyed by actual R1 instance and referenced from its scoped calls; it is not placed into JKI.pro or silently added to the approved JKS.runtime record

before_active_install: JKI six fields; q/seed exclusive; nonempty complete trigger.any and sources
all bit arrays aligned and no boolean bits
all trigger and source aliases explicitly bound
actual instance ownership and immutable definition resolution
real EX reference requirements and DAG after allowed self exclusion; no pool/tail/control exemption
no deletion or rebind of protected nodes
stage-specific required parameters and completion receipts
validation.publication_format: exactly one of the seven conversation-approved modes
validation.scope_note: design check validates static bindings and interface contracts; runtime must additionally instantiate and validate every real reference, EX dependency and DAG, using the specified closure construction; no claim that an unexpanded template is an already-legal active graph

stage_binding.R1.ACCEPT: lock current FRAME_IN admission and all actual input bit identities; do not reread latest DATA later
stage_binding.R1.CLAIM: bind current PRE head and existing frontier at entry; gate reads actual candidate/state q
stage_binding.R1.RESULT: bind exactly the originating run, PRE frame and available result/state locks; never select another run
stage_binding.R1.READ: bind preparation-request head, batch kind and source frame or immutable H snapshot; BUSY=1 yields normal NOOP retaining request
stage_binding.R1.RELAY: bind the preceding completed READ batch; prepare next batch only after all output locks of this batch exist
stage_binding.R1.COMPLETE: bind trusted completion batch; stale/replay completion is normal NOOP before any H/qualification EX
stage_binding.R1.DEC0/R1.DEC1: each independent DEC binds actual current POST head at its own EX entry, not ACK arrival
stage_binding.R1.ACT0/R1.ACT1: use frozen DEC bindings; revalidation cannot replace them with a later head
stage_binding.R1.GC: collect candidates at execution; normal NOOP if none eligible; active GC controller is not a deletion candidate

failure_handoff.factory_success: a draft and its identity are staged in the containing root; input-clear is part of that same root; no external visibility before commit
failure_handoff.installation_failure_after_child_return: root retains returned draft, its node id, actual frame locks and F1 candidates; retry the same operation, not a new factory edge
failure_handoff.root_abort: discard uncommitted active-node installs and restore candidate domain; reserved identities remain tombstones
failure_handoff.after_root_commit: input clear is durable with draft/install result; delivery failures resume existing outbox only
failure_handoff.failed_request_vs_new_input: a new b5=0 clears only its own admitted input state; it cannot erase saved call contexts or results

protocol_events.control_ready: v=1 means an actual phase completion, not a checksum or data bit value
protocol_events.data: 0 and repeated values are independent valid deliveries
protocol_events.clear: an explicit v=0 input-control delivery; zeroing a q does not by itself manufacture an event
protocol_events.no_hidden_wait: incomplete factory input rejects; missing business-stage parameters stay outside the stage FIFO task
